# NCTOH Workshop: Introduction to R

This page covers the basic R concepts used in the NCTOH workshop.

## Variables and data types

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# Numeric and integer values
x <- 5
int_value <- 2L
is.integer(int_value)
is.numeric(int_value)

# Character strings
name <- "Alice"

# Logical values
flag <- TRUE
```

## Factors and categorical variables

```{r, eval=FALSE}
gender <- factor(c("Male", "Female", "Male", "Female", "Other"),
                 levels = c("Male", "Female", "Other"))

physical_activity <- factor(sample(c(1, 2), 10, replace = TRUE),
                            levels = c(1, 2),
                            labels = c("Yes", "No"))
```

## Basic data structures

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# List
my_list <- list(name = "Alice", age = 25, scores = c(90, 85, 88))

# Matrix
my_matrix <- matrix(1:6, nrow = 2, ncol = 3)

# Data frame
sample_data <- data.frame(
  ID = 1:100,
  Name = sample(c("Alice", "Bob", "Charlie", "David", "Eva"), 100, replace = TRUE),
  Age = sample(20:50, 100, replace = TRUE),
  Height = sample(150:190, 100, replace = TRUE),
  Score = sample(60:100, 100, replace = TRUE)
)
```

## R functions and help

Use `?function_name` in R to see package documentation and usage examples.

:::
